races.name: Happy Birthday Fiona Walker Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Man Oh Man

runners_data.name: Blue In The West

runners_data.name: Locked Down Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with placing form, cheekpieces debut could address hanging issues shown at Chepstow
runners_data.comment: Cheekpieces could be an interesting addition as he did some hanging at Chepstow last time

runners_data.name: Greedy Smith
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who should get uncontested lead, cheekpieces need to sharpen focus after modest recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Pulled up and tailed off in two handicaps; cheekpieces need to do something
runners_data.spotlight: Nicely bred but hasn't raised his modest profile in two handicaps at about 3m the last twice; cheekpieces need to do something.

runners_data.name: Future Times
runners_data.note: Prominent type but 20-race maiden returning from long break, 14 lengths behind Vengeance last time out
runners_data.comment: Beaten about 14l in two runs after an absence; behind Vengeance last time
runners_data.spotlight: 20-race maiden who only recently returned from a mammoth absence; beaten about 14l on both occasions and behind Vengeance last time.

runners_data.name: Klervia

runners_data.comment: 25-1 and tailed off on stable debut over 2m7f here three weeks ago
runners_data.spotlight: 0-4 over hurdles for Barry Brennan; 25-1 and tailed off on stable debut over 2m7f here three weeks ago; that was after 256 days off but she has a lot to prove; cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Edna E Mode
runners_data.note: Prominent type with decent form last year on good ground but nothing in two handicaps since return
runners_data.comment: Nothing in two handicaps (on soft and good) since returning from a long break
runners_data.spotlight: Interesting on some of last year's form on good ground but nothing in two handicaps (on soft and good) since returning from a long break.

runners_data.name: Urban Isle
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse beaten long way in all three hurdle starts despite racing in high-class company
runners_data.comment: Pretty poor so far but entitled to be more competitive in this company on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Only minor promise in bumpers and beaten a long way in all three runs over hurdles, albeit two of those races were won by the first two home in the Supreme at Cheltenham; entitled to be far more competitive in this company on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Pillar The Poet
runners_data.note: Hold-up type recently sold for 1,000gns, remote fourth on handicap debut suggests limited ability
runners_data.comment: Third in a point before remote fourth on handicap debut at Taunton (2m3f; 16-1)
runners_data.spotlight: Left the Newland/Insole stable for 1,000gns last July, since when he's finished third in a point and a remote fourth on handicap debut at Taunton (2m3f; 16-1).

runners_data.name: Dawn's Desire
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with best effort when third at Fontwell, low weight could help if handling surface
runners_data.comment: Improved third at Fontwell; if okay on this drier ground then should have some chance
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced and best effort yet when third of five runners in her third handicap start at Fontwell (2m5f, soft); if coping with this surface then clearly has some sort of chance; 1lb out of the weights.

runners_data.name: Alderley Charlie
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who fades in finish, hopeless over fences with PFPP record, tongue-tie unlikely to help
runners_data.comment: He'll be glad to see the back of fences after producing form figures of PFPP
runners_data.spotlight: He'll be glad to see the back of fences after producing form figures of PFPP, not that a case can be made on hurdle exploits; tongue-tie added.

races.paceDynamic: Greedy Smith is the only confirmed front runner in this field and will likely dictate proceedings from the front without serious early pressure. Future Times and Klervia may track him in prominent positions, but neither appears keen to force the pace early. This should create a steady, sustainable gallop over the extended trip before quickening from two out. The lack of pace pressure and extended distance strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay and finish, particularly those with proven stamina at this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Greedy Smith sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where fresh finishers with proven stamina can unleash their kicks, negating the front runner's advantage. Vengeance and Man Oh Man benefit most from this tactical setup given their hold-up styles and recent form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Greedy Smith gets an easy lead and no serious challenge develops until too late
scenarios.body: The cheekpieces help Greedy Smith maintain concentration while the lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate completely. His stamina reserves prove sufficient when the field finally mounts a challenge in the straight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Future Times or Klervia track closer than usual and apply pressure from three out
scenarios.body: The increased pace exposes Greedy Smith's limitations while suiting horses who can travel strongly in behind before delivering their challenge. Klervia's stable form upturn could be significant here despite her poor comeback run.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and becomes a tactical affair throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of finishing speed rather than stamina, potentially suiting horses with turn of foot over proven stayers. This scenario could favour unexposed types or those dropping significantly in trip mentally.

watchPoints.text: Greedy Smith could steal this if allowed uncontested lead throughout as field lacks natural pace-forcers
Vengeance's recent Wincanton form looks solid but needs to confirm stamina at this extended trip
Man Oh Man's tongue-tie addition could be significant given his ability to hit the frame when right
Blue In The West's jumping errors last time are concerning given his previous consistent efforts here
Dawn's Desire carries just 142lbs and could be value if her Fontwell third translates to this surface

runners_data.name: Knight Of Magic

runners_data.name: Jet Joe
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with concerning fade-in-finish pattern, adding tongue-tie but minimal ability shown
runners_data.comment: Tailed off so far; dropped in grade with a tongue-tie added; market confidence needed
runners_data.spotlight: Made his debut in a race won by Sober Glory; again tailed off at Hereford in November; dropped in grade with a tongue-tie added; would need to see some confidence behind him.

runners_data.name: American Trio
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with fade-in-finish tendencies, visored for Fergal O'Brien but poor recent form

runners_data.name: Getone
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner for new trainer after 180-day break, new headgear fitted but concerning recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Some promise in Ireland; new trainer fits new headgear and lowers this 7yo's sights
runners_data.spotlight: It wasn't a desperate run when beaten 24l behind a useful horse in a Tramore maiden hurdle in October (yielding); new trainer fits new headgear and lowers this 7yo's sights.

races.paceDynamic: Knight Of Magic is the only natural front runner in this field and will get an uncontested lead from the outset. With all other seven runners carrying hold-up styles, Knight Of Magic will dictate a steady gallop throughout without any early pressure. The pace will build gradually as the hold-up horses begin their challenges from the back of the field turning for home. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter Knight Of Magic, as he can control the tempo without harassment and make his rivals come from too far back in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Knight Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Knight Of Magic jumps cleanly and maintains his rhythm unchallenged.
scenarios.body: The pace-setter exploits his tactical advantage with no early pressure, then has enough left to resist the late challengers. Sean Bowen can dictate ideal fractions and kick when the hold-up horses are still too far back to respond effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: French Mare Finds More
scenarios.trigger: If Madame De Labrunie travels strongly and produces her best finishing kick.
scenarios.body: The only horse with proven winning form at this level times her challenge perfectly as Knight Of Magic begins to tire. Jonathan Burke's mount has the class edge and Fergal O'Brien's yard is in better form than most trainers here.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Knight Of Magic stops quickly after setting uncontested fractions.
scenarios.body: The leaders falters dramatically in the final furlong, allowing a patient hold-up horse to sweep past. Getone or Sharp Tor could benefit most from a truly-run finish if they've been positioned well by their riders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Shock Winner
scenarios.trigger: If the main fancies all underperform and an outsider finds unexpected improvement.
scenarios.body: Upthereforthinking sheds his maiden tag with the visor helping, or American Trio responds to Fergal O'Brien's handling. The weak nature of this contest means any horse showing career-best form could spring a surprise.

watchPoints.text: Knight Of Magic's jumping under pressure - any mistake could end his tactical advantage when the field closes
Madame De Labrunie's position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance to use her superior class
How aggressively the hold-up horses move turning in - early moves could play into Knight Of Magic's hands
The pace through the early stages - if Knight Of Magic goes too fast he'll set it up for the closers
Upthereforthinking's attitude with first-time visor - any positive response could make him dangerous at big odds

runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 6yo who ran away with a weak handicap at Hereford 13 days ago (2m, good); pushed up 8lb for that but he was strong in the betting and probably has more to offer.

races.paceDynamic: Circle Of Secrets will be the only confirmed front runner in this small field, setting a sustainable pace without pressure from the start. Son Of Hypnos and Blacksamssenorita as prominent racers may track him but neither is aggressive enough to force the issue early. This creates a controlled tempo that gradually builds, with the real race beginning from the second-last hurdle. The moderate early pace followed by a sustained finish clearly favours hold-up horses who can close strongly, giving Western Cross and Arnie Moon significant tactical advantages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Circle Of Secrets sets his expected steady pace without early pressure
scenarios.body: The controlled tempo allows closers to conserve energy and unleash finishing kicks when it matters. Western Cross and Arnie Moon benefit most from this patient tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Son Of Hypnos or Blacksamssenorita pressures Circle Of Secrets earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field and creates a more honest gallop throughout. Blacksamssenorita's class edge becomes decisive as the finish approaches.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Circle Of Secrets gets loose on the lead with a big advantage turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace-setter builds an unassailable lead while the field fails to respond quickly enough. Circle Of Secrets' 54-day break becomes irrelevant as he times his peak perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Crawling pace sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes extremely sedate with all horses content to wait
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the last hurdle with stamina irrelevant. Arnie Moon's recent Hereford win suggests he has the sharpest acceleration for this finish.

watchPoints.text: Circle Of Secrets' fitness after 54 days off could see him fold tamely if the pace lifts approaching the finish
Son Of Hypnos pulled up badly on stable debut and amateur Stenhouse may struggle positioning-wise in the early stages
Western Cross showed promise in the hood last time and any market confidence would be highly significant
Blacksamssenorita's recent form collapse makes her vulnerable despite obvious class advantages
Arnie Moon's quick turnaround from Hereford could either catch him at peak fitness or leave him vulnerable

races.paceDynamic: Prairie Queen will lead from the start with no genuine pace rival, creating a controlled tempo that suits her front-running style. The prominent quartet of Land Girl's Luck, Loki's Mischief, Carrigmoorna Rowan and He'llstopatthetop will track closely but without creating early pressure. This measured pace will leave plenty in reserve for a sprint finish, with the hold-up horses Senor Diaz, Holy Legend, The Pit Popsy and Majestic Moment potentially gaining late momentum. The lack of early pace pressure clearly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position without stress and kick for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Queen gets an easy lead without early interference
scenarios.body: The mare can dictate throughout and has enough in reserve to repel late challengers. Her recent chase form suggests she can handle the jumping under pressure while maintaining her rhythm.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners bunch up and interfere with each other 2-3 out
scenarios.body: The congestion allows a hold-up horse to find a clean run and capitalise on the disruption ahead. Majestic Moment or Senor Diaz could benefit from a clear passage when others are scrimmaging.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Prominent Surge
scenarios.trigger: If Land Girl's Luck or Carrigmoorna Rowan travel sweetly and avoid the traffic
scenarios.body: Their superior ratings tell as they outgun Prairie Queen in the final furlong. The controlled pace plays into their hands perfectly for a sustained challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Queen goes too slow and the field bunches dangerously at the business end
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where jumping errors or interference can decide the outcome. Any horse finding a clear run could capitalise on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Prairie Queen must be watched for jumping errors under pressure as the uncontested leader approaching the final three fences
Carrigmoorna Rowan to watch for any signs of bleeding given she bled two runs back and showed nothing last time
The prominent quartet of Land Girl's Luck, Loki's Mischief, Carrigmoorna Rowan and He'llstopatthetop for traffic problems 2-3 out
Holy Legend for any signs of reluctance at fences given she refused two runs ago
Majestic Moment for fitness after 144-day layoff despite coming home alone last time at Fontwell

races.paceDynamic: Dyno Dave will take this race by the scruff of the neck from the start, with only three runners ensuring no early pressure on his lead. Saint Cyr De Pail and Mahler Moon will track behind but neither has the natural pace to challenge Dyno Dave's supremacy in the opening stages. The sustained gallop will suit the leader who can dictate terms throughout, potentially stretching the field approaching the final circuit. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can travel kindly in the early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dyno Dave Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Dyno Dave jumps cleanly and maintains his rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: Henderson's charge can control the tempo completely and kick for home when it suits, with his recent good ground victory proving he handles these conditions. The lack of pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a decisive move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mahler Moon Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and Dyno Dave weakens
scenarios.body: O'Brien's runner has the best recent form and can pick up the pieces if the leader's stamina gives way over this extended trip. His prominent style keeps him in touch to pounce when others tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Saint Cyr Strong Stayer
scenarios.trigger: If the trip brings significant improvement from Saint Cyr De Pail
scenarios.body: The step up to three miles could unlock untapped stamina reserves, allowing him to grind past tiring rivals in the final stages. His recent third here suggests he handles the track despite the poor finishing position.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If all three runners struggle with the combination of trip and pace
scenarios.body: The race becomes a survival test with jumping errors or stamina failures opening the door for any horse still travelling. Form and ratings become secondary to who can simply complete the course most efficiently.

watchPoints.text: Dyno Dave's jumping under pressure - any significant errors could end his front-running advantage quickly
Saint Cyr De Pail's stamina reserves over this extended trip - completely unproven beyond 2m4f
Mahler Moon's ability to quicken when the pace lifts - needs to show tactical speed to capitalize on his form edge
The overall pace given small field size - could become stop-start affair that negates natural running styles
James Bowen's tactics on Dyno Dave - whether he restrains early or lets his mount bowl along naturally

races.name: Totnes And Bridgetown Races Company Ltd Open Hunters' Chase

runners_data.name: Daisy Yeats
runners_data.note: Front-running style but 340-day absence and poor recent form make pace sustainability highly questionable
runners_data.comment: Sole point win came when finishing alone and that was in 2023; absent since last May
runners_data.spotlight: Sole point win came when finishing alone and that was in 2023; absent since last May.

runners_data.name: Franco De Port
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with Grade 1 class who ran surprisingly well after 978-day layoff, proven at this distance
runners_data.comment: Former Grade 1 winner; long absence prior to a very pleasing third at Warwick
runners_data.spotlight: Former Grade 1 winner for Willie Mullins but a long time ago; however, after a mammoth absence of 978 days he ran surprisingly well at Warwick (3m, good to soft), finishing under 9l behind Golden Son who went on to finish fourth at Cheltenham last month; this 11yo clearly retains some of his old ability.

runners_data.name: Macklin
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent recent form including course win last month, clear form pick on rules evidence
runners_data.comment: 7-11 in points and his rules form is useful, winning here last month; the one to beat
runners_data.spotlight: 7-11 in points and his rules form is useful, having finished third at Cheltenham last May and winning as he liked here last month; looks the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Assassins Lullaby
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but poor 2-34 point-to-point record and struggling form make him unreliable
runners_data.comment: Only 2-34 in points and has struggled badly in that scene this year; no appeal
runners_data.spotlight: Only 2-34 in points and has struggled badly in that scene this year; no appeal.

runners_data.name: Mr Glass
runners_data.note: Non-runner - prominent style would have added pace pressure
runners_data.comment: On debut for this yard he was 40-1 here last month and finished well behind Macklin
runners_data.spotlight: Won races for Paul Nicholls and Will Biddick but on debut for this yard he was 40-1 here last month and finished well behind Macklin.

runners_data.name: Stumps Or Slips
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong going preference (4W7P on good ground) but 89 days since last run
runners_data.comment: Fell three out at Taunton in January when running well; decent latest run in a point
runners_data.spotlight: Bought out of Olly Murphy's yard for £26,000; on the retreat but had run well when falling three out at Taunton in January and was close up behind respected opposition in his latest point; could go well.

runners_data.name: High Game Royal
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with tactical speed, solid recent Stratford run suggests return to form
runners_data.comment: Beaten in two points before finishing well held at Stratford
runners_data.spotlight: Won over hurdles in 2023 for the Hobbs/White operation; beaten in two points before finishing well held at Stratford recently.

runners_data.name: Windance
runners_data.note: Prominent style but 66-1 and tailed off behind Macklin here last month shows current limitations
runners_data.comment: 66-1 when tailed off behind Macklin here last month
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins under rules divided between hurdles and fences but at an ordinary level; 66-1 when tailed off behind Macklin here last month.

runners_data.name: Gateau De Miel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but pulled up in Macklin's race here and only third in subsequent point
runners_data.comment: 18-1 when pulled up in Macklin's race here last month
runners_data.spotlight: 18-1 when pulled up in Macklin's race here last month and only third of four runners in subsequent point.

runners_data.name: Corporal Jackjones
runners_data.note: Non-runner - prominent style and recent hunter chase win would have added early pace
runners_data.comment: Has a lot more on his plate here than when scoring at odds-on at Stratford
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of three points and added a hunter chase last month at Stratford (2m5f, soft; fine on good); however, that was very winnable and he went off odds-on; has plenty more on his plate here.

races.paceDynamic: Daisy Yeats is the only confirmed front runner but faces sustainability questions given her 340-day absence and poor recent form. Several prominent runners including Assassins Lullaby, High Game Royal, and Windance could press forward if Daisy Yeats falters early. The pace is likely to be genuine but not frenetic over this 3m trip, with the tempo building gradually through the middle stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can pick off tired leaders, as the prominent pack may go too hard trying to exploit any early pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Daisy Yeats maintains the lead and several prominent runners track her closely creating sustained pace.
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop over 3m will set up perfectly for the proven staying hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks. Franco De Port and Macklin, both tactical hold-up performers, can time their challenges to perfection in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Daisy Yeats stops quickly due to her long absence and no other horse takes up the running effectively.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl with bunched field turning for home, suiting prominent runners with tactical speed. High Game Royal and the improving types can quicken off the slower gallop better than the pure stayers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Acceleration
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady early but one of the hold-up horses makes a bold mid-race move to shake up the field.
scenarios.body: This creates a stop-start tempo that can catch out horses not traveling well, favoring those with race fitness and adaptability. Macklin's recent form and Franco De Port's class could see them dictate when the race begins in earnest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners including Assassins Lullaby and High Game Royal engage in early pace pressure with Daisy Yeats.
scenarios.body: The resulting fast early fractions will ensure a strong gallop but may compromise the prominent runners' finishing kicks. Pure closers like Stumps Or Slips who can stay off the early pace battle gain maximum advantage.

watchPoints.text: Daisy Yeats may stop quickly early due to 340-day absence, creating tactical chaos if no other horse takes over
Franco De Port's jumping under pressure after long layoff could be vulnerable if asked to quicken late
Macklin's weight advantage and course familiarity make him dangerous if getting first run on his rivals
Several prominent runners may go too hard early trying to capitalize on Daisy Yeats' likely weakness
Stumps Or Slips needs monitoring for market support given his excellent record on good ground
